run_unsupervised_multilingual_alignment: run unsupervised multilingual word embedding alignment across multiple languages using a pivot language
run_gromov_wasserstein_initial_alignment: run gromov-wasserstein optimal transport to compute initial bilingual alignment between two embedding sets
run_rcsls_loss_optimization: run recursively constructed sparse least squares loss optimization to refine cross-lingual alignment matrices
run_l2_loss_optimization: run l2 loss optimization with sinkhorn transport to align word embeddings across language pairs
run_convex_initialization: run convex initialization with sinkhorn iterations to compute an initial alignment between two embedding sets
